title: Return-Shipping Keep-Back on Northgate Marketplace Keep-It Refunds
content:
**Returns desk tariff — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** The return-shipping keep-back taken from the keep-it refund applies to a change of mind on a seller program where the buyer pays change-of-mind return shipping, standing in for the return trip the buyer no longer pays: on such a Freight Seller order it is the order's shipping charge divided by the order's units times the requested units; on such an order of any other seller program it is the order's shipping charge times the price paid for the requested units divided by the order's merchandise total; for any other reason or program there is no keep-back; the order's units are the units bought across its lines.

**Who pays change-of-mind return shipping, by program.**

| Seller program | Change-of-mind return shipping paid by | Keep-back on a change of mind |
|---|---|---|
| Seller-Fulfilled | the buyer | yes |
| Pro Seller | the seller | no |
| Fulfilled by Northgate | Northgate | no |
| Freight Seller | the buyer | yes |
| Certified Renewed | the seller | no |
| International Seller | the buyer | yes |

**Hypothetical figures.**

- Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller order, change of mind, shipping charge USD 60.00 on an order of 4 units, 1 unit requested: 60.00 divided by 4 times 1, that is 15.00 kept back.
- Northgate Marketplace International Seller order, change of mind, shipping charge 20.00, price paid for the requested units 50.00, merchandise total 200.00: 20.00 times 50.00 divided by 200.00, that is 5.00 kept back.
- Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller order, change of mind: the seller pays that return shipping, so nothing is kept back; a defective-item request on any program: nothing is kept back.
